instruction: Apply a teal background to the slide and change the title font to Arial.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide background to teal (#008080) and changing title font to Arial.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: background color check + formatting/notes check

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic flaw in title shape detection: getter uses 'first shape with text' approach instead of checking for title placeholder
The current logic in getters/pptx.py:36-39 iterates through all shapes and returns the first shape with non-empty text, which may not be the title placeholder
In slides with multiple text boxes, this could extract formatting from wrong elements (e.g., body text, captions, annotations)
Background color extraction logic is correct and will work properly
Expected values are semantically correct: teal (#008080) for background and Arial for font
Metric comparison logic is sound for both requirements
Postconfig correctly saves the file before evaluation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: In getters/pptx.py, replace the title detection loop with proper placeholder detection: check if shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type in [1, 3] (TITLE or CENTER_TITLE enum values)
Alternative: Use shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PLACEHOLDER to identify placeholder shapes first
Add fallback: if no title placeholder found, then use the first text shape as current logic does
Consider handling edge case where slide has no title placeholder at all
